description: Reference history without 2024-01-31 (a weekday the WEEKDAYS_SYNTHETIC calendar says traded), after the zone formed.
explanation: D27 / D34: a missing session after a zone formed means its freshness cannot be established (the missing candle may have touched it). Unknown freshness is never fresh: the overlay marks the zone UNKNOWN_DATA_GAP, blocks it with disposition DATA_INSUFFICIENT, and the execution series stops at the gap so G0 is DATA_INSUFFICIENT for the symbol.
title: A missing session after formation: overlay unknown, not a candidate
